archive_policy.rule: When the current phase is completed, move its full progress and validation evidence to the archive before creating a fresh progress.json for the next phase.

phase.title: Human Playtest and Core Feel
phase.goal: Deliver Internet-hosted dedicated rooms joined by custom room ID, package a reproducible Windows client, observe structured 3–8-player Internet sessions, and tune core feel from evidence before expansion. Start with one server machine; preserve clear room-service/gameplay boundaries for future refactoring, not mass-scale infrastructure.

milestone_2_1_reproducible_windows_playt.title: Reproducible Windows Playtest Build
milestone_2_1_reproducible_windows_playt.scope: Create a repeatable Windows export with build/version identification; verify standalone launch without adding distribution services.
milestone_2_1_reproducible_windows_playt.acceptance: Export twice from the same clean revision with matching payload hashes or documented packaging-only differences; launch on native Windows without editor/repository, with matching build identity and no missing resources. See docs/implementation-checklist.md for the executable plan.

milestone_2_2_playtest_readiness.title: Internet Rooms and Playtest Readiness
milestone_2_2_playtest_readiness.scope: Implement playerless authoritative dedicated servers, one process per room on one machine, a small HTTPS room service with custom ID lookup/admission, and Windows create/join UI. Validate multi-container isolation/lifecycle and actual Internet release-client sessions before human baseline. No hundred-thousand/million-user design or optimization; additional machines are a future refactor.
milestone_2_2_playtest_readiness.acceptance: Execute Tasks 2.2.3–2.2.7 in order per docs/implementation-checklist.md. Previous LAN requirement is superseded, not passed; retain prior evidence. Room service allocates/admit clients only; Godot server owns gameplay. Rebuild/version-check both client and server. Docker evidence does not pass real Internet or human listening gates. Public deployment/shared infrastructure changes require specific approval.

milestone_2_6_mouse_and_display_reliabil.title: Mouse Interaction and Display-Session Reliability
milestone_2_6_mouse_and_display_reliabil.scope: Execute after 2.2 and before 2.3; stable ID preserves existing milestone references. Reproduce missing camera rotation/button clicks on Linux/X11/llvmpipe with --host-port=29730, distinguish game event routing/capture/focus from OS/display loss, fix the proven cause and validate actual pointer events across gameplay/UI/focus/recovery states plus native Windows regression. Investigate X-connection loss and cleanup diagnostics separately without inferring a cause from the pasted log. See checklist for reproduction and acceptance.

milestone_2_3_human_playtest_baseline.title: Human Playtest Baseline
milestone_2_3_human_playtest_baseline.scope: Observe a 3–4-person session and a 6–8-person session on separate Windows PCs over Internet room-ID joining; aim for three normal rounds each and record client/server builds, server hardware, region/network latency and disconnects alongside input/display setup, uncoached death explanations, warnings, camera/control/fairness issues, voluntary rematches and timestamped emergent causal chains.

milestone_2_4_core_feel_improvements.title: Core-Feel Improvements
milestone_2_4_core_feel_improvements.scope: Prioritize reproduced high-impact issues; tune existing movement/camera/warning/pacing owners one coherent change at a time and regress. Create tasks from actual findings, not speculative tuning. No new disasters, shove, map expansion or distribution services.

milestone_2_5_follow_up_validation_and_p.title: Follow-Up Validation and Phase Review
milestone_2_5_follow_up_validation_and_p.scope: Retest affected scenarios and normal rounds with humans at both group sizes; compare baseline and follow-up evidence. Report actual durations against the configurable 8–12-minute target. If criteria fail, remain in Phase 2 and return observed issues to 2.4 before repeating 2.5.

proposed_expansion_criteria.death_clarity: At least 80% of sampled deaths correctly explained without coaching; report numerator and denominator.
proposed_expansion_criteria.voluntary_rematches: A majority independently willing to rematch in each follow-up group; distinguish requested rounds from voluntary requests.
proposed_expansion_criteria.emergence: At least two distinct emergent causal patterns recurring across rounds.
proposed_expansion_criteria.stability: No unresolved session-blocking/control failures; recurring high-impact issues addressed with regression and human follow-up evidence. Small samples are product evidence, not statistical proof.
